title: Can you find the movie that inspired this scene ?
author: Sector_92_Katane
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/1nrefkv0xwkg1.gif

A scene I'm working on, can you guess from witch movie it's inspired and name the original bar ?

comments.author: BornNeedleworker9942
comments.body:
Blade Runner or Sleepless in Seattle.


Which in engine is this? And did you vibe coded it?

replies.author: Sector_92_Katane
replies.body:
None of those movies :/

  
The engine is Unreal Engine 5. No vibe coding, Ai was used only for 3D modeling characters and some objects.  
All scripts are handmade by myself using Blueprints
